correctness.rationale: Four unused zones are exactly justified by position order. The resulting core starts 00, ends 11, and each core position is active. If monotone, its multiplicity is a product of positive triangular numbers, not five. Otherwise an inversion gives an 001011 subsequence with exactly five occurrences, and activity rules out extra core positions. Reconstruction yields a unique four-part weak composition and coefficient. checker.py passes exhaustive and independent recurrence tests; those are corroborative, not the proof.
